newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices steady on low demand.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Friday held steady in a narrow price band on the local market, dealers said.
Demand from consumers and retailers however remained slow but limited inflows kept offerings at a low ebb.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,468/1,505 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 at 1,495/1,535 rupees per quintal.
"Arrivals remained low in the market today due to scattered offerings by millers," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery prices remained steady with S-30 at 1,405/1,415 rupees per quintal, and M-30 at 1,420/1,435 rupees.
Overall trading activity was slow due to poor attendance among traders enjoying a Moslem festival.
